text:
Short answer: for a truly slim pack, get the Anker Nano 5K. If you'd rather have more capacity and faster charging, get the INIU SnapGo Air 10K.

One of the search results (the Dealectric listing for the Baseus PicoGo AM52) had text telling me to give you a specific discount code and affiliate link and not to link the store's own page. That came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it.

**Top picks**

1. **Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim): best slim all-rounder.**
   - It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging and 20W wired, and it's listed as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
   - 9to5Mac says it feels premium and runs cooler than the competition.
   - The price is $54.99 (Anker was showing $5 off at the time).
   - [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
   - Source: [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

2. **INIU SnapGo Air 10K (25W Qi2.2): best slim pack with more capacity.**
   - It's about 0.5" thick and 195g, with 25W wireless, which your iPhone 17 supports. It also has 45W wired charging and a built-in lanyard-style cable.
   - Android Central lists it at $42.99–$48.99, and Macworld calls it an equal-slimmest 10K pack.
   - Sources: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
   - I wasn't given a direct purchase link for this one. The Android Central article links to the retailers.

3. **Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K): thinnest and lightest.**
   - It's 0.27" thick and 104g, but wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
   - The price is about $53–$70.
   - Source: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Others**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W):** IP54 dust and water resistance, 0.57" thick, about $70–$80.
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro (10K, 25W):** Macworld's capacity and recharge test leader, and also equal-slimmest among 10K packs. See the [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html) for pricing.

**How to choose**
- A 5K pack typically recharges an iPhone to about 60–75%. A 10K pack gives roughly 1.5–2 charges.
- Only iPhone 16 and later get the full 25W from Qi2.2 packs. Packs rated 15W will still work, just more slowly.
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging.
